product_metadata.title: 10 Pack 2.5v Clear Replacement Christmas Light Bulbs
features: Generic baseless bulbs perfect for replacing old bulbs
Each pack comes with 10 glass light bulbs
2.5v/0.17amp clear light bulbs with round base
Fits virtually all mini Christmas light strings that use rounded base bulbs
Bulbs with Balsam Hill specific bases are sold separately
description: These generic replacement baseless bulbs by Balsam Hill are ideal for replacing broken or burnt out bulbs while keeping the same light bulb base style to ensure a perfect fit with your existing light strings. This model features 10 clear lights with a round bulb base. Be sure to order bulbs with the base style (round or slotted) that match your existing bulbs. If you are replacing bulbs in a Balsam Hill product, we recommend instead purchasing bulbs with the correct Balsam Hill plastic base, rather than baseless bulbs, to make replacing burnt out bulbs easier.
